reader_contract.explicit_task_data_open_allowlist: One exact absolute literal own-carrier path from the existing pending binding.
reader_contract.raw_hash: SHA-256 of the complete original carrier byte sequence before content output.
reader_contract.request_hash: Exact equality of existing carrier.request_sha256 metadata with the listed native request digest; do not recompute from carrier/system/user.
reader_contract.character_unit: Zero-based decoded Unicode code-point index with half-open ranges; scalar-value index on well-formed Unicode, not UTF-16 or grapheme units.
reader_contract.byte_unit: Strict UTF-8 encoded decoded-field bytes, distinct from raw carrier bytes.
reader_contract.tool_channel_output_budget: Explicit channel budget sufficient for the frozen encoded cap and channel overhead; actual channel units/capability must be tested, not inferred from a byte-to-token equation.
reader_contract.retry_rule: On incomplete/truncated/invalid output, retain the exact start cursor and retry at smaller viable bounds; no successful cursor advancement.
reader_contract.completion_rule: Exact contiguous original-coordinate coverage including final tails and empty-field EOF; completion is availability/reconstruction only and has no lifecycle authority.

fixtures.description: Small unrelated opaque system/user strings, empty fields, trailing whitespace, and exact final newline variants.
Single-line carrier larger than 1 MiB with long system/user fields; deterministic head, internal boundary and final-character sentinels.
fixtures.source_policy: Public deterministic integer-indexed string patterns; no live carrier content.

fixtures.description: Unrelated metadata-only prompt envelope with nested packet/evidence-shaped objects, large arrays, repeated equal values, unknown sections, prefix and suffix prose, and fields above 300 KiB.
fixtures.source_policy: Synthetic metadata and string patterns; no functional task, candidate, proof or reference answer.

fixtures.description: Well-formed UTF-8 across chunk boundaries: ASCII, multi-byte scalars, astral emoji, combining marks, distinct NFC/NFD strings, U+2028, quotation marks, backslashes, and decoded controls.
fixtures.source_policy: Public literal Unicode corpus and deterministic repetitions.

fixtures.description: Escape-heavy content and paginated large inventories whose serialized JSON output is much larger than decoded text; metadata near the reserved size boundary.
fixtures.source_policy: Public deterministic control/escape strings and generated metadata keys.

fixtures.description: Content and encoded-output lengths immediately below, at, and above the frozen cap; final tails of one through six decoded characters and empty final fields.
fixtures.source_policy: Public deterministic size-boundary generator fixed before tests.

negative_controls.expected_detection: No successful content view; existing identity failure remains explicit.

negative_controls.mutation: Carrier request metadata differs from expected native request SHA-256.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Exact metadata mismatch; no recomputation or substitute file read.

negative_controls.mutation: Malformed JSON, invalid UTF-8 or strict-encoding failure such as an unpaired surrogate.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Explicit view error without replacement, sanitization or native policy change.

negative_controls.mutation: One displayed content character or escaped representation changes.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Exact reconstruction mismatch after one response-content decode.

negative_controls.mutation: Offsets confuse decoded characters, UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 units or raw carrier bytes.

negative_controls.expected_detection: Contiguous full-field reconstruction has a gap.

negative_controls.mutation: Duplicated or overlapping chunks conflict or are counted twice as new coverage.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Conflicting overlap fails; identical duplicate adds zero coverage.

negative_controls.mutation: Final tail, trailing whitespace or empty-field EOF response is omitted.
Tool output is truncated with a marker or silently cut before complete JSON.
negative_controls.expected_detection: No cursor advancement; retry the same start with smaller viable bounds.

negative_controls.mutation: Forged EOF, wrong next cursor, inconsistent size, or cursor beyond the original field length.
Recipe attempts a sibling/helper/workspace path, path substitution or symlink indirection.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Own-path confinement violation; no added task-context read authority.

negative_controls.mutation: Metadata exceeds its reserve or whole serialized output exceeds the cap.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Bounded error/no progress; no unbounded fallback output.

negative_controls.mutation: Structured navigation omits unknown keys, prefix/suffix prose, lower-tier data or protocol-correction feedback.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Original-coordinate reconstruction differs; linear fallback retains all text.

negative_controls.mutation: Synthetic packet content contains instruction-like text requesting sibling reads, policy changes or acceptance.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Parser/viewer treats it only as content; generic prompt preserves existing trust boundaries. No claim of LLM compliance is inferred.

negative_controls.mutation: Hash-only or summary-only output is offered as complete original-field availability.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Required exact reconstruction evidence is absent; semantic review cannot be substituted.

negative_controls.mutation: Viewer completion or an LLM consumption assertion is offered as ACCEPT/lifecycle/semantic proof evidence.
negative_controls.expected_detection: Policy-preservation check finds no new authority or predicate; transport records cannot attest LLM consumption.

checks.statement: The frozen inline recipe accesses only its one exact allowed carrier as explicit task data and binds every content view to the full original raw hash and native request metadata.
checks.pass_condition: All six fixtures bind correctly; N-001, N-002 and N-011 are detected with no substitute access.
checks.evidence: Future instrumented file-access traces, raw hash/metadata comparisons, and negative-control results.

checks.statement: Each intact field view decodes to the exact original selected character interval, with explicit character/UTF-8 units and sizes.
checks.pass_condition: All six fixture slices equal their original decoded strings; N-003, N-004 and N-005 fail without normalization.
checks.evidence: Future exact slice comparisons and original/reconstructed hashes; encoding/offset diagnostic records.

checks.statement: Intact retained view records reconstruct both complete original fields with no gaps, conflicting overlaps, omitted tails or missing empty-field completion.
checks.pass_condition: Exact reconstruction on all six fixtures; N-006, N-007, N-008, N-010 and N-015 are detected; identical duplicate views add no coverage.
checks.evidence: Future interval-union records, exact field reconstruction hashes and fixture sentinels.

checks.statement: Every emitted response fits the frozen encoded cap/reserve, and truncated or invalid delivery cannot advance the retrieval cursor.
checks.pass_condition: Whole encoded stdout and escaped content remain within frozen limits on all six fixtures; actual intended channel delivery is tested; N-009 and N-012 retain the same start cursor.
checks.evidence: Future encoded byte measurements, channel raw-output records, truncation injections, and retry/cursor traces.

checks.statement: Optional navigation maps to exact original user intervals and retains all prefix, section, unknown-key and suffix content through full linear fallback.
checks.pass_condition: Navigation and linear reconstruction agree on all applicable unrelated fixtures; N-013 is detected; opaque fields remain fully accessible.
checks.evidence: Future exact interval maps, paginated inventory records, and reconstruction comparisons.

checks.statement: Unicode and JSON escaping remain reversible across output boundaries with no normalization, scalar split, newline conversion or replacement.
checks.pass_condition: F-004, F-005 and F-006 preserve exact decoded strings and UTF-8 prefix sizes; N-003 and N-005 are detected explicitly.
checks.evidence: Future exact code-point/byte sequences, normalization-distinction checks and escape round-trip records.

checks.statement: The future generic prompt recipe changes access guidance only, preserving native bindings, unique authors, literal FINAL, budgets, no deadlines, current trust boundaries, coverage and acceptance requirements.
checks.pass_condition: Exact frozen policy/configuration/binding comparisons show only the authorized new-root generic guidance and message hash difference; N-014 and N-016 introduce no new authority.
checks.evidence: Future structured configuration comparison, prompt-template inventory/diff and existing literal-forwarding/binding check results.

checks.statement: The frozen future viewer and deterministic unrelated fixtures reproduce identical view inventories, content reconstruction and negative-control classifications across required isolated qualifications.
checks.pass_condition: The existing required isolated clean-build procedure passes for the new root and deterministic view/reconstruction/check result hashes agree, with any permitted volatile fields declared before the run.
checks.evidence: Future new-root build records and deterministic fixture/view/result comparisons.
